main_text.p: suam ad generalem illam legem pertinere neget, & ab illa quoad potest eā abducat? Ex harum autem altercationū consistione nascitur quęstio, quæ iam non ad Titiū, aut Męuium, nec ad arborē, oleam forte, aut pinum, sed cum ad personas omnes, tū ad res quasuis solo adiectas pertinet: An ea demum superficies solo cedat, quæ illi adhærescit? Qua ex re uim istius artis eā quam diximus esse apparet, nimirū ut quęstionem certis personis Titij & Mæuij, certaque re; oleæ scilicet, aut quercus, finitam ac terminatā, ad infinitā, nullis

page.notes: Running head is in decorative black type and could not be read; left as illegible. Long s (s, st ligature) normalised to s throughout. The word "nullis" is split across the last two lines ("nul" / "lis"); written whole without a hyphen, since no hyphen is printed. "Męuium" and "quęstio" keep the printed ę; the first letter of "Męuium" is not fully certain. Page number 106 is printed at top left. No catchword or signature is visible. Faint show-through at the foot is ignored.
